title: Iterating VALUES of a one-side column, the measure on the blank row is the orphans' amount

source.quote: The values obtained for the group-by columns include the blank values of invalid relationships
source.supports: the page gives SUMMARIZECOLUMNS as an optimized ADDCOLUMNS over VALUES of the group-by column, blank row included

source.quote: the VALUES function treats the blank row as a regular row, returning it. On the other hand, DISTINCT never returns the blank row
all the different values of Sales[ProductKey] with no corresponding row in Product are linked to the single blank row
source.supports: orphaned rows are linked to the blank row

derivation: VALUES ( Product[Color] ) is Red, Blue and the blank row's BLANK. Context transition filters Product[Color] to each: Red 100 (Sales row 1), Blue 30 (row 2), BLANK selects the blank row, to which Sales rows 3 and 4 are linked: 50 + 20 = 70.
